lines.say: Hey! Welcome to the Mad Monkey V I G and G E Hub!
lines.caption: Hey! Welcome to the Mad Monkey VIG & GE Hub!

lines.say: It's one link, with everything you need for your job.
lines.caption: It's one link, with everything you need for your job.

lines.say: Here's how it works!
lines.caption: Here's how it works!

lines.say: First up, find your property.
lines.caption: First up, find your property.

lines.say: Tap your country, then tap your hostel. Easy!
lines.caption: Tap your country, then tap your hostel. Easy!

lines.say: This is your property page!
lines.caption: This is your property page!

lines.say: Tap, Make this my property, and it'll be right at the top every time you come back.
lines.caption: Tap "Make this my property" and it'll be at the top every time you come back.

lines.say: This is the hostel's local time. Always post in hostel time, not your own!
lines.caption: This is the hostel's local time. Always post in hostel time, not your own!

lines.say: Here's your guest WhatsApp group!
lines.caption: Here's your guest WhatsApp group!

lines.say: Post tonight's events in there, between two and four in the afternoon.
lines.caption: Post tonight's events in there, between 2pm and 4pm.

lines.say: Underneath is the hostel's Instagram. Post Stories in the morning!
lines.caption: Underneath is the hostel's Instagram. Post Stories in the morning!

lines.say: The login is in the shared password manager. No access? Just ask your G M or Marketing.
lines.caption: The login is in the shared password manager. No access? Just ask your GM or Marketing.

lines.say: Below that are your tools.
lines.caption: Below that are your tools.

lines.say: The Experience Dashboard shows every event and tour. If it's not on the dashboard, don't post it!
lines.caption: The Experience Dashboard shows every event and tour. If it's not on the dashboard, don't post it!

lines.say: And Mad Monkey Studio is where you make your event images.
lines.caption: And MM Studio is where you make your event images.

lines.say: Now, back to the home page, and down to the guides.
lines.caption: Now, back to the home page, and down to the guides.

lines.say: The V I G S O P explains your daily jobs.
lines.caption: The VIG SOP explains your daily jobs.

lines.say: The Playbook has ready-made WhatsApp messages. Let's open it!
lines.caption: The Playbook has ready-made WhatsApp messages. Let's open it!

lines.say: Pick the right template.
lines.caption: Pick the right template.

lines.say: Tap Copy, paste it into WhatsApp, and fill in the real details.
lines.caption: Tap Copy, paste it into WhatsApp, and fill in the real details.

lines.say: Before you hit send, tick through the checklist.
lines.caption: Before you hit send, tick through the checklist.

lines.say: If anything's unclear, just ask before you post.
lines.caption: If anything's unclear, just ask before you post.

lines.say: That's it! Your property, your tools and your guides, all in one place.
lines.caption: That's it! Your property, your tools and your guides, all in one place.

lines.say: Have fun out there!
lines.caption: Have fun out there!
